'''February 2001 Findlay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Findlay, Ohio on 17 February 2001. [[Brad Eier]] won it. It is known from Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1737">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-findlay-ohio-2-17-01d1737/ findlay-ohio-2-17-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 17 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-findlay-ohio-2-17-01d1737/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Findlay, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Eier]]
